why: Lane B's fakes read as arrays (exec/fake.mjs, design/fake-throw.md). An iteration method a fake answers (forEach, map, filter, some, every, find, flatMap, reduce) runs its callback over the fake's elements in order, like a real array, and a throw inside the callback is the unit's throw; the length of a fake is its drawn shape and is not recorded, so a forEach and a counted for over it make the same requests. An answer the unit casts with `as T`, where the declared answer names no shape, is drawn at T (exec/spec.mjs). labels is the pyka repro reduced: a forEach whose callback throws on a fake element, rewritten as a counted for: the same throw on both sides, PASS-bounded (it was a WITNESS when the fake swallowed the throw). safeLabels catches the throw inside a map callback and returns a default: WITNESS, a fault against a value. total is a reduce whose callback throws on the second element, rewritten as a counted for: PASS-bounded. count is untouched. queried casts an unknown answer to an array of records and iterates it: drawn at the cast type, the forEach and the counted for agree, PASS-bounded (a shapeless answer such as 0 made forEach throw where the loop skips). The units take untyped values, so lane A refuses them by design and the pair checks lane B alone.
